overview.description: The VistaShares Space Supercycle ETF (GALX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund actively invests in a portfolio of stocks globally tied to the space economy. Investments are expected to be concentrated across underlying hardware, infrastructure, and enabling technology. GALX was launched on Jul 15, 2026 and is issued by VistaShares.

holdings.infoBox: GALX is an equity ETF with a total of 63 individual holdings. The top holdings are Rocket Lab stock at 4.37%, MACOM Technology Solutions Holdings at 4.22%, AMETEK at 4.03%, MDA Space at 4.01%, and Moog Inc. at 3.71%.
